title: The Vanishing Customers

storyline.headline: TrendMart's repeat customers are disappearing
storyline.summary: Repeat customers fell 18% last quarter. The CEO suspects pricing, marketing blames competitors, and operations points to delivery delays. Your consulting team has one day to identify the likely cause.

objectives: Build an evidence-based view of why repeat customers are leaving TrendMart.
starterCode: # Start by understanding the evidence TrendMart shared
hints: Before testing any theory, inspect what information is available in each evidence file.
A strong investigation compares retention patterns with operational performance and customer voice.
businessInsight: Delivery delays are concentrated in cities with the weakest repeat-customer retention and the highest delivery-related complaints.
recommendation: Prioritise a delivery recovery plan in Delhi and Mumbai: audit late-order handoffs, communicate proactively with affected customers, and measure repeat purchase recovery weekly.
businessQuestion: What is the most likely driver behind TrendMart's 18% loss in repeat customers?
strategy: Identify variables that describe repeat behaviour, delivery performance, and complaints.
Validate whether late delivery and complaint patterns move together.
Prepare a recommendation that the client can act on.

handbook.heading: Comparing groups
handbook.whatItDoes: Grouping a measure by a business category reveals patterns that row-by-row reading hides.
handbook.useCase: Use it to compare cities, channels, products, or teams.

handbook.heading: Checking data quality
handbook.whatItDoes: Missing values and unexpected labels can change a conclusion.
handbook.useCase: Use it before relying on any operational report.
